主题：Q1 Renewal Approvals - Green Light List
Hi team,

Here are the accounts that have been green-lit for Q1 renewal based on our latest customer health review:

APPROVED FOR RENEWAL:
- Vanguard Logistics (001xx000003REN1) - health score 92, strong engagement
- Pinnacle Systems (001xx000003REN2) - health score 87, renewed training last quarter
- Cobalt Engineering (001xx000003REN3) - health score 78, but legal has flagged a pending issue - hold on this one until legal clears it

NOT YET APPROVED:
- TerraForm Analytics (001xx000003REN4) - health score 54, active churn risk, scheduling executive call first

Please only send renewal notifications for the approved accounts. I'll follow up on TerraForm separately.

Thanks,
Jun Nakamura
CS Team Lead"}
